description: This header file defines the interface for a plugin main module related to a SNMP plugin, including function declarations for initialization, object support checking, unloading, and memory management. It also includes licensing information and macro definitions.
external_files: COSA_PLUGIN_INFO (implied as a type passed as a pointer)

methods.name: COSA_Init
methods.description: Initializes the SNMP plugin with maximum supported version and plugin info.

methods.name: COSA_Async_Init
methods.description: Performs asynchronous initialization of the SNMP plugin.

methods.name: COSA_IsObjectSupported
methods.description: Checks if a specific object name is supported by the plugin.

methods.name: COSA_Unload
methods.description: Unloads or cleans up the plugin resources.

methods.name: COSA_MemoryCheck
methods.description: Performs a memory check within the plugin.
